ttlock_client_id.title: Client ID
ttlock_client_id.description: TTLock Open Platform application client ID (https://euopen.ttlock.com)

ttlock_client_secret.title: Client secret
ttlock_client_secret.description: TTLock Open Platform application client secret

ttlock_username.title: Username
ttlock_username.description: TTLock account username (recommended: the plugin logs in and renews the token automatically)

ttlock_access_token.title: Access token
ttlock_access_token.description: Alternative to username/password: a pre-generated access token (it cannot be renewed automatically)

ttlock_api_base_url.title: API base URL
ttlock_api_base_url.description: TTLock API base URL, e.g. https://api.sciener.com or https://euapi.ttlock.com

refreshInterval.title: Refresh interval
refreshInterval.description: How often (in seconds) to refresh lock state and battery level. Minimum 30, 0 disables polling.

whiteList.description: Only expose locks with these names or IDs (empty exposes all)

blackList.description: Never expose locks with these names or IDs

webhook.title: Webhook (real-time records from the TTLock cloud)
webhook.description: Optional. When someone uses a fingerprint, card, passcode or key, the TTLock cloud tells the plugin right away, including who and how.

publicUrl.title: Public URL
publicUrl.description: The internet address that reaches this Matterbridge on the port below, e.g. https://lock.example.com from a Cloudflare Tunnel or ngrok. It must be reachable from the internet: a local address like http://192.168.1.10 will NOT work, because the TTLock servers call it.

port.title: Port
port.description: Local port the webhook listens on (forward your tunnel to it).

url.title: Your webhook URL
url.description: Filled in by the plugin after you enable the webhook, set the public URL and restart. Copy it into your TTLock Open Platform application as the callback URL.

localControl.title: Local control (Bluetooth through an ESP32)
localControl.description: Optional. Control the locks directly over Bluetooth through an ESPHome Bluetooth proxy (ESP32) near the lock: faster, works without internet, and shows fingerprint/keypad/auto-lock changes instantly. The ESP32 must be dedicated to this plugin: remove it from Home Assistant.

mode.title: Connection mode
mode.description: auto: Bluetooth first, the cloud if that fails. local: Bluetooth only. cloud: TTLock cloud only (ignores the ESP32). Local control is only used when the ESP32 address is set.

espHost.title: ESP32 address
espHost.description: IP address or hostname of the ESPHome Bluetooth proxy, e.g. 192.168.1.60. Leave empty to disable local control.

espEncryptionKey.title: ESP32 API encryption key
espEncryptionKey.description: The "api: encryption: key" from the ESP32 ESPHome configuration (base64). Leave empty if the API is not encrypted.

espPassword.title: ESP32 API password (legacy)
espPassword.description: Only for old ESPHome configurations that use an API password instead of an encryption key.

useAppAccount.title: Get Bluetooth keys from the TTLock account
useAppAccount.description: Download the locks Bluetooth keys with the TTLock username/password above (the same way the TTLock app does). The first time, TTLock may email you a verification code: enter it below and restart.

verificationCode.title: Verification code
verificationCode.description: Only when the log asks for it: the code TTLock sent to your email/phone.

bluetoothKeys.title: Bluetooth keys (JSON, optional)
bluetoothKeys.description: Alternative to the account download: paste the lock key JSON, e.g. the "keys" of the TTLock BLE integration from Home Assistant (.storage/core.config_entries). Keep it private.

readLockHistory.title: Read who/how from the lock history
readLockHistory.description: After someone uses the lock, briefly connect over Bluetooth to read how it was opened (fingerprint, card, passcode...). Uses a little more battery, and the lock may then not upload those records to the TTLock app history. Not needed if the webhook is enabled.

debug.description: Enable debug logging for the plugin

unregisterOnShutdown.description: Unregister all devices on shutdown (development only)
